summary: Trivial delegation thunk: reads the global PhysicsSolverWrapper and forwards its value as the integer argument to BooleanToIntConversion, returning the conversion result directly. No branches, no local state.

operations.description: Load the global PhysicsSolverWrapper from 0x00599868 as the integer argument passed to the callee.
Call BooleanToIntConversion with the loaded global value as its sole argument.
Return the result of BooleanToIntConversion unchanged.

unresolved: Semantic role of the global PhysicsSolverWrapper (value interpreted as a boolean by the callee) is caller-dependent and unknown here.
